title.zh: 筛选达人并确认商务合作

goal.zh: 完成达人筛选、建联、佣金谈判与合作档期确认。
goal.en: Complete creator selection, outreach, commission negotiations, and campaign scheduling.

title.zh: 完成卖点、脚本与直播素材
title.en: Finalize selling points, scripts, and livestream assets

goal.zh: 完成卖点提炼、短视频脚本、直播话术与素材交付。
goal.en: Deliver product selling points, short-video scripts, livestream talking points, and creative assets.

title.zh: 完成直播彩排与上线执行

goal.zh: 完成直播排期、场控清单、彩排和上线异常预案。
goal.en: Finalize broadcast scheduling, production checklists, rehearsals, and launch contingencies.

title.zh: 确认价格机制、库存与履约

goal.zh: 锁定商品价格、赠品机制、库存数量和履约方案。
goal.en: Lock product pricing, promotional gifts, inventory quantities, and fulfillment arrangements.

title.zh: 制定投流计划并控制 ROI
title.en: Plan paid media and control ROI

goal.zh: 确认投放预算、定向、人群包和 ROI 目标。
goal.en: Confirm advertising budgets, targeting, audience segments, and ROI targets.

title.zh: 搭建数据看板并完成复盘
title.en: Build reporting and complete the retrospective

goal.zh: 统一 GMV 指标口径、渠道归因和项目复盘模板。
goal.en: Align GMV definitions, channel attribution, and the campaign retrospective template.

title.zh: 完成素材宣称与合同合规审核
title.en: Review marketing claims and contract compliance

goal.zh: 审核广告法、素材宣称、达人合同和平台规则。
goal.en: Review advertising rules, creative claims, creator contracts, and platform requirements.

title.zh: 新品防晒衣抖音达人带货项目
title.en: Sun-protection apparel creator campaign on Douyin

goal.zh: 统筹新品防晒衣抖音达人带货项目，以 9 月 15 日上线和 GMV 50 万为目标，协调达人、内容、直播、商品、投流、数据和合规交付。
goal.en: Coordinate creators, content, livestreams, merchandising, paid media, reporting, and compliance for a September 15 launch targeting GMV of 500,000.
